## Scope and proof accounting

This is infrastructure provenance, not a formal release result. Lean target/exit/wall/RSS/swap/axioms belong to per-module rebuild receipts. Inventory itself launches no Lean or Kani. Rc2_Top.deployed is unchanged: before/after exact source and ledger delta are recorded separately; no premise removed and no new security/non-vacuity conclusion. The two Aeneas library sources have separate archive-member provenance, and unchanged library objects are separately pinned, never counted as project compiles.
